en: GSC window 14 Jul→10 Aug (all 28 rows of the Days tab summed by hand for the exact total instead of the rounded '1.52K' tile; the hand-summed clicks total of 79 matches the Total clicks tile and the hand-computed CTR of 5.19% matches the 5.2% tile): clicks 72→79, impressions 1,415→1,521, queries-with-impressions 148→153, CTR 5.1%→5.2% and average position improved 30.6→30.4. The strongest single day in the window is 10 Aug with 8 clicks on 135 impressions.

Reminder: GSC and GA4 are rolling 28-day windows. The delta against 12 Aug is the window shifting (one new day in, one old day out), not any single day's traffic. Today's window dropped 13 Jul off the back and pulled in 10 Aug (135 impressions, 8 clicks).

This is the first day after two flat ones where clicks and average position both moved the right way: +7 clicks and a 0.2-place improvement in average position. But it is worth being precise about where those 7 clicks came from — almost entirely brand: 'dxliving' 40→43 and 'dx living' 22→24, together 67 of 79 clicks (~85%). All 8 non-brand queries in the top 10 still return zero clicks.

The non-brand picture still has not converted: 'best home builders adelaide' went 105→110 impressions and still returns 0 clicks at average position 34.5; 'best house builders adelaide' 23→26; 'quality home builder adelaide' (21) entered the top 10 for the first time, pushing '3d rendering companies melbourne' (20) off the table. Coverage keeps widening but stays parked in the 28–58 rank band.

MEASUREMENT ALERT — GA4 IS STILL NOT FIXED, now day 15. Measured today: 30 Jul–5 Aug = 1 session, 6–12 Aug = 1 session. Two consecutive 7-day windows both reading 1 session is noise around a zero floor, NOT a recovery signal. Checked directly on the live homepage: 0 GTM/gtag script tags loaded, window.gtag and window.google_tag_manager both undefined, dataLayer holds a single entry, no G- measurement ID.

Against 12 Aug not one detail of the root cause changed: still 4 GTM snippet copies, 7 raw gtm.js string occurrences in outerHTML, 2 <noscript> iframes, the same GTM-PZ9N8QTR container, the #dx-analytics-dedupe script still present and the __dxGtmLoaded flag still true. The remedy is identical: delete #dx-analytics-dedupe outright, then remove 3 of the 4 remaining snippets.

CONSEQUENTLY: every 28-day GA4 figure in this snapshot (sessions 203, engaged 136, key events 15, users 111, total events 1,395) is an under-count. The drop against 12 Aug (223/148/15/114/1,500) is NOT a traffic decline — it is the pre-29-Jul portion of the window shrinking a day at a time. In roughly 13 more days the 28-day window will read close to zero unless this is fixed.

AI assistant channel: still exactly 1 session from chatgpt.com / ai-assistant (0.49% of total), 100% engagement, 15 seconds, 7 events, 0 key events — no Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot appears anywhere in the source/medium table (all 12 rows paginated through). This figure also sits inside the window affected by the tracking fault.
